currentCoordinate.coordSource: OpenStreetMap Ring 3 explicit mainline routeSegments: 180 ways across two unbranched carriageways; display midpoint on way 4341399
currentCoordinate.coordNote: Batch 178 route topology production: fresh OSM resolves Ring 3's explicit trunk mainline into exactly two unbranched endpoint-connected carriageway chains, with 91 and 89 ways and lengths 17970.9 m and 17888.5 m. Both chains explicitly carry Ring 3 in ref and together cover the rv. 150 and E6 overlap sections. All 180 mainline ways are stored as routeSegments. A detached 134.4 m Ring 3-tagged side component is excluded because it is not part of either complete end-to-end carriageway. The canonical lat/lon is the deterministic length midpoint of carriageway 1 and lies on OSM way 4341399, which is used as the display coordinate source. No nearest/first-hit segment and no legacy symbolic midpoint is used.
